StateTree.Comment: Combat subtree for Enh Shaman bots (run by STAI_Combat_Shaman.xml)

Task.Comment: the totems selected for the bot (outdoor, or the master's dungeon stage) that are not up: needs, onTotemMissing; onTotemsChanged when the selection changed

State.name: Totems
State.Comment: a selected totem is not up: drops the missing totems one per GCD; fails while none can be cast (mana), not selected again for 3s

Task.Comment: placeholder until the spec's combat exists: waits briefly (a totem that failed is tried again) or until a delegate sends the tree elsewhere
